F3 (22:56–23:04) drove 4.61 km where the optimal route covers 2.14 km, adding 2.46 km. No exemption applies: there is no rider message at all in the record (F9), and the driver's post-trip statement "The GPS rerouted me" (F10) is a claim written after the trip, not a rider message sent before 22:56:55 — it is neither consent under RD-5 nor an excuse under RD-4, whose incident screen the trace marks ✗ [F9][F10][RD-5][RD-4].

F4 (23:08–23:14) drove 4.07 km where the optimal route covers 0.71 km, adding 3.37 km. The same reasoning holds: no pre-segment rider message (F9), and the driver himself concedes no consent and no traffic justification [F9][F10][RD-5][RD-4].

RD-4 does not excuse either segment: the trace records no qualifying incident on the replaced stretch, F13 records no incidents near the route in the trip window, and F11/F12 show only band 4 (30–39 km/h) on East Coast Parkway and Airport Boulevard — band 4 is neither band 1 nor band 2, so RD-4(b) gives no standalone exemption and RD-4(c) sends both segments back to RD-2. F14 (fair, 0.0 mm rain) adds nothing [F11][F12][F13][F14][RD-4].

Amount, per the trace formula Σ extra_km × (distance_fare ÷ distance_km): rate = $39.42 ÷ 27.96 km = $1.4099/km [F8]; 5.83 km × $1.4099/km = $8.2197, i.e. $8.22 (2.46 km from F3 + 3.37 km from F4). The residual 0.66 km between F5's billed excess of 6.49 km and the 5.83 km of named segments is corridor/map-matching mileage that RD-2 excludes, and the $0.02 metered waiting time in F6 stays with the driver under RD-3(c) [F3][F4][F5][F6][RD-2][RD-3].

RD-6's flag is not triggered: F16 shows 0 route disputes upheld in the last 90 days, so there is no "repeated" breach and the structured flag_account field stays false [F16][RD-6]. Per NS-7 the refund issues as a Ryde voucher, not cash [RD-2][NS-7].
